why: Evelyn Christenson's dates in chapter 11, in every edition: she died on 1 November 2011 at 89 (Pioneer Press obituary; Wikidata; Revive Our Hearts), not in 2013. Her birth is known only as 1922: the exact birthday given (1 November, her death day), the middle names "Maxine Wheeler" and the birthplace Muskegon are unconfirmed and are dropped. Found while writing A Cloud of Praying Witnesses, Vol. 10.
